authentication: Supabase JWT plus getUser; no diagnostics request override
urlProtection: Compile-reviewed HTTPS origins and registry layer URLs only; no user URL/source/diagnostics input; credentials, query/hash and redirects rejected
apnProtection: Registry field whitelist, constrained APN characters, leading zeros retained, no caller SQL
viewportProtection: Zoom 16+, bounded local viewport; county-crossing bounds return ambiguity
rateLimit: Existing database RPC: public_parcel, 20 requests/user/minute; per-isolate provider courtesy/backoff/circuit
knownLimit: Per-isolate cache/courtesy is not distributed provider-wide throttling; public activation requires a separate review
